limitations: Frame-level items cover the 153 catalog rows plus items discovered from restored sources; other original image containers are not enumerated here.
A status describes artwork or text existence and review, not runtime integration; the runtime field is separate.
Catalog statements that no change is required were taken from the catalog and not re-derived from pixels.
Text groups count records, not unique lines; candidate text has no verified translation quality.
Palette variant relevance for MAINROM weekday frames is not established; a frame is english-reviewed when every known variant is.
Nothing here is human approval except the historical exact review events.
Weekday HUD frames are english-reviewed only when every source palette variant in source_identities has an approved English image; otherwise the weakest variant decides.

Group decision records in translations/en/graphics/decisions/*.json are kept as provenance (evidence, defaults, catalog corrections); the inventory reads only their folded status, reason and notes from atom_overrides here, and candidate status still comes from the hash-bound ledgers.
